title: decisions and features wait on exactly the conditions they need

criteria.text: A condition is a record with a why, owner, status (not started, partial, met, withdrawn) and the check that decides it
Conditions have parts; a parent's status is computed from its parts, never set by hand
A condition can be a number crossing a line, decided by a scheduled query
criteria.note: Built in #1225 (scheduled-check job) [V]. Checked: `[guards F126.3]` in `tests/knowledge-conditions-job.test.ts`.

criteria.text: Two ways to wait: `starts when` and `ends when` links to any condition or part; waiting on one part does not wait on the whole
Both questions in one call each: what does this condition unlock, and what is this waiting on, following parts all the way down
criteria.note: `unlocks` and `waits_on` are in `src/lib/knowledge/tools.ts` and the migration; #1225 left them to the lookup tool (#1226) [V]. Checked: no `[guards F126.5]` marker anywhere, so no.

criteria.text: One batch when something is met: one GitHub Issue lists everything it starts or ends
Parked means parked: an agent asked about parked work answers with the condition; the store refuses to mark parked work as building
criteria.note: Store half built: `is_parked` and the refusal (#1225) [V]. The agent's-answer half was left to #1219; no 'parked' handling found in `src/lib/knowledge/*.ts` [A: `waits_on` may serve it]. Checked: only `[guards F126.7 partial]` in `supabase/tests/knowledge_conditions.sql`.

criteria.text: Runs without a computer: checks run on a GitHub Actions schedule; the PM marks a condition met or withdrawn from his phone
criteria.note: `knowledge-conditions.yml` runs daily 15:17 UTC and by hand [V]. Checked: only `[guards F126.8 partial]` in `tests/knowledge-conditions-job.test.ts`; the phone mark-met path has no whole marker, so no.

criteria.text: Today's waiting lines come in as proposals: `[for now]` until-text and scenario `gates:` / `depends:` become proposed conditions, listed in one Issue
criteria.note: Not built [V]: #1225 PR body 'Left to an import follow-on (F126.9)'; the condition kind has no `proposed` status and `scripts/knowledge/conditions.ts` has no import of waiting lines. No Issue existed before this report.
